title: Repoise repository configuration (schema version 1)
description: Committed root configuration for the offline-first repository knowledge indexer. Configuration is data only; it is never executed. Secret material must be referenced through environment variables, never stored here. The local operator override file repoise.local.json uses the same shape.

schemaVersion.description: Configuration schema version. Must be 1 for this build.

preset.description: Corpus preset. docs-only indexes documentation and configuration only; docs-code-lexical (default) adds offline lexical code indexing; hybrid adds embedding search and requires an explicitly selected provider.

inheritGitIgnores.description: Whether native Git ignore files (.gitignore, .git/info/exclude) are inherited (default true). Secret deny rules and containment checks always remain enforced.

include.description: Narrow gitignore-style re-include patterns. A broad include never overrides secret deny rules or mandatory containment.

exclude.description: Extra gitignore-style exclude patterns applied after package defaults.

maxFileBytes.description: Maximum file size in bytes accepted into the corpus (default 1048576). Larger files are skipped with a diagnostic.

documentRoles.description: Configured role mappings: gitignore-style pattern to document role. Last matching rule wins. Explicit front matter still takes precedence.

cacheDir.description: Generated-data directory, kept out of the corpus by default (default .repoise). Never point this into version control.

embedding.description: Optional embedding provider settings (operator-selected, never mandatory). Secrets resolve only through environment references.

provider.description: Provider name chosen by the operator.

endpoint.description: Endpoint reference; must be an environment reference like env:VAR_NAME, never a literal secret-bearing URL.
